conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but also limits upside potential. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns.

balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for risk-first growth, targeting ~2.5%/month. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while blending broad index exposure with quality tech. Expect moderate volatility and drawdowns.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It leans into leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups, significantly raising both upside and drawdown potential. Be aware of daily decay/rebalancing in leveraged ETFs and the potential for substantial losses if stops are not strictly adhered to.

plan: Trim SPY to 20% to cure concentration and meet the single name cap. Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero, eliminating all leveraged ETF exposure. Sell CRWD to zero, eliminating high-beta single name exposure. Add to QQQI, targeting 30%, to prioritize income for monthly distributions. income.read: This income plan aims to park cash for yield, targeting ~1%/month. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff; this is not a savings account.
